يحتملن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَمِلْنَ (yaḥtamilna) /jaħ.ta.mil.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# يُحْتَمَلْنَ (yuḥtamalna) /juħ.ta.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
